international.title: Fifa confirms cyber-attack exposed ‘personal and business information’
international.summary: Football’s governing body says hackers accessed a limited set of personal and business data Fifa confirmed that hackers gained access to a “limited set of personal and business information” in a cyber-attack, amid heightened concern over digital vulnerabilities of leading organizations and institutions. The global soccer governing body said it “condemns in the strongest possible terms the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data”, in a statement to the Associated Press on Thursday. “Such actions constitute a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy and can have significant consequences for the individuals concerned.” Continue reading...
